name: Desperate_1
short_caption: The robot briefly raises its right hand to chest height and extends its left hand outward in a pleading, desperate gesture.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral posture and raises its right arm to chest height, curving its hand inward, while simultaneously extending its left arm outward with an open, downward-facing palm. Its head tilts slightly during this brief asymmetric pose, conveying a sense of pleading or desperation. It then smoothly lowers both arms back to its sides and returns to a neutral, forward-facing posture.
